podcast.body: Shirley Bassey, a Welsh singer with a background in theater, performed the theme song for the 1964 James Bond film "Goldfinger." The song became a top 40 hit despite initial strong hatred from producer Harry Saltzman, who called it "the worst blanking song I've ever heard in my blanking life." Its success led to Bassey becoming the first singer to perform multiple Bond themes. "The singer is Shirley Bassie, a Welsh singer who started in the theater."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
